scope: Independent source and inventory review of five guest audience cases. Proposal only; no canonical inventory, runtime behavior, or execution credit changed.

shared_boundary.finding: Vault and Tools already have signed-in audiences. App uses the same predicate for navigation triggers, content mounting, stale selected-tab recovery, and lazy preload. Tools Smart tests and Recorder exist only under ToolsView; PasswordGenerator exists only under VaultView in the current side panel.
shared_boundary.boundary_note: This is an existing side-panel render boundary, not a proposed new gate or a claim that all underlying tools and routes deny guests.
shared_boundary.alternate_selection: src/entrypoints/sidepanel/App.tsx:532-540 can select Vault from an assistance button; setTab itself has no authorization logic (src/state/sidepanel-tab.ts:37-40), but the App content condition still prevents VaultView mounting for a guest. The stale-tab effect returns to a public tab. No current URL deep-link parser or persisted tab state was found in that store, so the two 'saved deep link' case steps should be exercised as stale/programmatic selection only if a test can actually create it.

cases.case_criteria: Guest cannot open Vault; signed-in tab/content absent or denied with an honest sign-in path.
Guest cannot open Tools; signed-in tab/content absent or denied with an honest sign-in path.
Guest cannot reach Tools Smart tests or its Run control through visible navigation.
Guest cannot reach Tools Recorder, Record, or list management through visible navigation.
Guest cannot reach Vault password generator; signed-in Vault becomes reachable.
cases.inventory_correction: Feature 2017 entry_points says 'Tools tab → Vault password generator'; current source mounts PasswordGenerator in VaultView under the Vault tab. Correct this before or alongside mapping.

B_quality_and_proposal.implementation_constraint: Document the current parent-tab visibility and content gate. Do not add a runtime audience gate, imply direct guest access to child components, or treat this source review as native guest verification.

new_control.label: Guest cannot open Vault tab
new_control.action: In a signed-out side panel, verify Vault navigation and content are unavailable, including a stale/programmatic Vault selection; an available sign-in path remains. Confirm a signed-in user can open Vault.

proposals.rejection_reason: C05 is the guest Sign in action inside VaultView; it does not establish whether App hides or blocks the Vault tab/content.

new_control.label: Guest cannot open Tools tab
new_control.action: In a signed-out side panel, verify Tools navigation and content are unavailable, including a stale/programmatic Tools selection; an available sign-in path remains. Confirm a signed-in user can open Tools.

proposals.rejection_reason: Catalog, Smart tests, and Recorder tab-open controls describe signed-in child navigation, not the guest Tools audience boundary.

new_control.label: Guest cannot open Tools Smart tests
new_control.action: In a signed-out side panel, verify the Tools parent tab is unavailable, so Smart tests and its Run controls cannot be reached through visible navigation; an available sign-in path remains. Confirm signed-in navigation reaches Smart tests.

proposals.rejection_reason: Expand and Run Summarize controls describe signed-in scenario interactions, not the guest parent-tab boundary.

new_control.label: Guest cannot open Tools Recorder
new_control.action: In a signed-out side panel, verify the Tools parent tab is unavailable, so Recorder, Record, and list management cannot be reached through visible navigation; an available sign-in path remains. Confirm signed-in navigation reaches Recorder.

proposals.rejection_reason: Start recording and dismiss-error controls describe signed-in Recorder actions, not guest exclusion.

new_control.label: Guest cannot open Vault password generator
new_control.action: In a signed-out side panel, verify Vault is unavailable, so generator controls are unreachable; an available sign-in path remains. After sign-in, confirm Vault and its generator can be reached.

proposals.rejection_reason: Expand generator and Use generated value are signed-in interactions, not guest audience coverage.

limits: This is a current-source and inventory mapping review only; no native side-panel execution, artifact receipt, or coverage credit is claimed.

The case wording 'saved deep link' in 2011-T05 and 2012-T03 is stronger than the current in-memory tab store supports; actual URL/persistence path should be established before claiming that test branch.
Each child feature gets its own traceable inventory control even though the implementation is the same parent tab gate; this is inventory duplication, not a request for duplicate code.
